name: MCP for Blender
description: ahujasid/blender-mcp (package mcp-for-blender): control the open Blender through its add-on.

requires.name: Blender
requires.hint: Install the add-on from the project page in Blender and start its server

instructions: Uses the same Blender add-on port as CMCP's built-in Blender tools; keep only one of them on.
